title: Goldreich–Levin candidate membership
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $i$ be a coordinate in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, and let $A$ be a finite family of subsets of the coordinates. A set $T$ belongs to the family formed by taking, for each $S\\in A$, the sets $S$ and $S\\cup\\{i\\}$ if and only if there is some $S\\in A$ such that $T=S$ or $T=S\\cup\\{i\\}$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite family $A$ of subsets of the coordinates
